title: 'NashVegas Getaway' w/ Hot Tub Near Broadway
description:
Country-Boho Kitsch | Indoor-Outdoor Flow | Dog Friendly w/ Fee 

Trade cookie-cutter for colorful at this one-of-a-kind Nashville vacation rental! Bursting with eclectic style, this maximalist mélange pairs bold interiors with inviting outdoor spaces featuring a hot tub, fire pit, and grill. Spend your days exploring Broadway, the Ryman, and Centennial Park, then come home to unwind in unforgettable surroundings. Cue your most vibrant 'NashVegas Getaway' today!

The space
201801

OUTDOOR LIVING
- Covered patio w/ hot tub, checkers & darts
- Open-air patio w/ grill
- Wood-burning fire pit
- Adirondack chairs, high-top seating, loungers, benches
- Large yard
- Lush greenery & vibrant flowers

INDOOR LIVING
- Maximalist interior w/ eclectic decor
- Smart TVs
- Dining room, high chair
- Board games & books

KITCHEN
- Refrigerator, stove/oven
- Keurig (coffee provided), blender, toaster, microwave
- Cooking basics, dishware & flatware, trash bags/paper towels
- Spices

ACCESSIBILITY
- Single-story home, 2 steps to enter 

PARKING
- Street parking (2 vehicles)

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire property via keyless entry

Other things to note
- No smoking
- Pet friendly w/ $50 fee (+ fees & taxes, dogs only, 1 max)
- No events, parties, or large gatherings
- Additional fees and taxes may apply
- Photo ID may be required upon check-in

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
- Homeowner on-site (separate unit)

SECURITY CAMERA INFORMATION
- 2 exterior devices
- Location: front & back of home
- Coverage: front & back perimeter
